column1: # Disposition triage for gs.map -- components with NO verdict from curation/status.toml.
# Fill `verdict`: live | closed | gone | delete      (blank = still undecided)
#   live   = real place, entrance edge merely unrecorded -> walk it later
#   closed = exists, shut right now, expected back -> draw, do not route
#   gone   = removed or retired, nothing scheduled -> do not draw
#   delete = bookkeeping stub -> remove the room entirely
# Built ignoring `event transport` edges (seasonal, untraversable out of season).
# The 33 rules in curation/status.toml already cover 5516 rooms and are not listed here.
